newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SOCCER-DATE FOR ROETHLISBERGER APPEAL SET.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DATE FOR ROETHLISBERGER APPEAL SET.

text.p: Swiss referee Kurt Roethlisberger, who received a life ban for attempted bribery, will have his appeal heard next Thursday, UEFA said on Friday.

Roethlisberger was handed the ban last week after a UEFA investigation found he had approached Zurich Grasshopper with an offer to fix the Swiss club's Champions league match against French champions Auxerre on October 30.
Roethlisberger said he knew the referee and could easily arrange to have the match fixed for 100,000 Swiss Francs ($68,000).
Once recognised as one of soccer's top officials, Roethlisberger will have his case heard by the UEFA Control and Disciplinary Committee at a Geneva hotel.
